name: What materials are low-profile thresholds made from?

mainEntity.name: What materials are low-profile thresholds made from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low-profile thresholds are commonly available in various durable materials, including aluminum, stainless steel, oak, and other hardwoods. Aluminum is popular for its strength, corrosion resistance, and sleek appearance, often chosen for exterior doors. Wood thresholds offer a classic look and can be stained to match existing flooring. The choice of material depends on factors such as traffic volume, exposure to elements, and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low-profile thresholds are typically made from durable materials like aluminum, stainless steel, and various hardwoods.
